description: This file provides utility functions for handling symbolic links and reparse points on Windows, including creating, reading, and deleting symlinks, as well as walking directory trees with special handling for reparse points.

methods.name: ToDevicePath
methods.description: Converts a DOS path to a device path to avoid MAX_PATH limits on Windows.

methods.name: _RemoveEmptyDirectory
methods.description: Attempts to remove a directory with retries, changing permissions if necessary.

methods.name: _RmtreeOsWalk
methods.description: Walks directory tree to delete files and directories, handling reparse points.

methods.name: _RmtreeShellCmd
methods.description: Deletes directory tree using shell command.

methods.name: RmtreeShallow
methods.description: Deletes a directory tree without following symlinks, emulating Linux behavior.

methods.name: ReadReparsePointShell
methods.description: Reads reparse point information via shell command.

methods.name: ReadReparsePoint
methods.description: Reads reparse point link, falling back to shell command if necessary.

methods.name: IsReparsePoint
methods.description: Checks if a path is a reparse point (symlink).

methods.name: CreateReparsePoint
methods.description: Creates a reparse point (symlink or junction) between directories.

methods.name: _IsSamePath
methods.description: Checks if two paths refer to the same location.

methods.name: OsWalk
methods.description: Emulates os.walk() on Windows, handling reparse points as symlinks.
